import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
assert all((root / x).is_dir() for x in ('models','utils','sample_data'))
def audit(event,args):
    if event=='open' and isinstance(args[0],str) and Path(args[0]).suffix in ('.parquet','.csv','.npz','.npy','.pt','.pth'):
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected scientific input read')
sys.addaudithook(audit)
from paper.scripts import run_titantpp_mlp_cap36 as runner
runner.install_hooks()
from paper.scripts import run_multilag_detail_execution as base
from paper.scripts.count_aware_tpp_backbone import training
from paper.scripts import titantpp_mlp_cap36_runtime,manage_titantpp_mlp_cap36
from paper.scripts.run_count_aware_tpp_backbone_control import parse_args
from paper.scripts.run_taxi_quantity_interface_ablation import make_loader
from simple_lab_test.common.pathing import resolve_project_root
assert resolve_project_root(base.__file__).resolve()==root
modules={n:str(Path(v.__file__).resolve()) for n,v in tuple(sys.modules.items()) if getattr(v,'__file__',None) and n.split('.')[0] in ('models','utils','data_loader','simple_lab_test','paper')}
assert all(Path(p).is_relative_to(root) for p in modules.values())
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','project_modules':len(modules),'root_and_module_paths_match':True,'scientific_input_reads':0,'model_inference':False}))
